ns2:course.label: Asian Americans & Inequalities
ns2:course.description: An examination of various forms of social inequality between Asian Americans and other groups as well as among Asian Americans, including those based on race, gender, class, citizenship and sexuality. Same as AAS 328. Prerequisite: SOC 100 and/or AAS 100 are recommended.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as AAS 328. Prerequisite: SOC 100 and/or AAS 100 are recommended.
